sloka: धिगस्तु कुब्जामसतीं मन्थरां पापनिश्चयाम्।यन्निमित्तमिदं दुःखं कौसल्या प्रतिपत्स्यते ।। ६.९३.५९ ।।
transliteration: dhigastu kubjāmasatīṁ mantharāṁ pāpaniścayām।yannimittamidaṁ duḥkhaṁ kausalyā pratipatsyate ।। 6.93.59 ।।

translations.english: 'Son killed, Kausalya will be disappointed, lost sentience will be offering obsequies, surely and enter fire or water and drown'.
